g.text: Low-poly lighthouse prop for a stylized top-down 3D prototype:
weathered 1930s stone-and-iron lighthouse, 4 m tall in-game scale,
teal-painted tower with brass trim, pale glass lantern room, 1k-2k
textures, no rig, single mesh under 8k tris, UV-mapped, PBR-ish flat
shading. Include a separate rotating beam mesh (unlit emissive
plane) as a second object. Muted teal-and-brass palette. GLB format.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
